notes.design_decision: OutputTarget and the plan IR are pigment's (render_plan.rs; v1 types are literal-built by dependents) and outside this lane's ownership, so the transform is declared on the backend (Renderer / GpuBackend / SharedDevice builder) and bound into the receipt through the exactness ledger key display_clip_sources, not into OutputTarget or the plan digest. The clip is applied at the SOURCE boundary, not after compositing, because pigment's blend arithmetic (the single owner, CX-CAP-001) has no extended-range domain: an extended composite to clip does not exist. Source clip == stage-6a clip of the extended composite when every clipped sample reaches the output through opaque Normal source-over (a developed raw layer shown alone, the viewer case); otherwise it differs, hence class Approximate (UNVERIFIED against Photoshop 32-bit preview, D5)
